card.text: Icy moon of Saturn scarred by the huge Odysseus crater and the Ithaca Chasma canyon.

introduction.text: Tethys is almost entirely water ice. Two small moons, Telesto and Calypso, share its orbit.

normal.title: Global image mosaic
normal.summary: Source pixels span 293 m in the 2012 mosaic; detail is uneven and shadows remain.

enhanced.title: Enhanced-color composite
enhanced.summary: Infrared, green and ultraviolet bands reveal color differences beyond human vision.

iss.title: Cassini ISS narrow-angle image
iss.summary: One Cassini photograph taken from 190,000 km, projected onto the shape.

elevation.title: SPC terrain model
elevation.summary: Height above or below a 531 km sphere from Cassini's 2025 SPC model, with about 1.5 km spacing.

relative-albedo.title: SPC relative brightness model
relative-albedo.summary: Brightness solved with the Cassini shape, relative to an average of 1; not visible color or reflectance.

shape.title: SPC shape model
shape.summary: Plain surface over a 2,000-face version of Cassini's Q128 shape, without height exaggeration.

infrared.title: Cassini VIMS regional spectra
infrared.summary: False color from 2.02, 1.59 and 1.28 µm where Cassini observed, with lighting still in the values.

ice-absorption.title: VIMS regional water-ice absorption
ice-absorption.summary: Water-ice absorption near 2.02 µm; viewing angle and grain size affect it, so it is not ice abundance.
